user.title: Connect your Argon UPS
user.description: Enter the serial device path visible to Home Assistant Core. Prefer /dev/serial/by-id/. Stop other software using this port first. On Raspberry Pi 5, missing UPS USB detection may require a manual boot setting (dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host). See the installation guide; this integration cannot read or change HAOS boot settings.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read a valid UPS status. Check the device path, permissions, USB connection and exclusive port access.
error.invalid_port: Enter a local serial device path, not a network URL.

abort.already_configured: This serial device is already configured.
